comment: Standing research topics the desk watches (RESEARCH_WATCHLIST). The operator edits this file to add/change sources; on server boot it seeds researchTopics. When a village agent adds a topic through the intent lane, it is appended here so you see their additions in the same file. cadenceMs is how often the crawl fires (floored to 5 minutes); linkKeyword/pageKeyword filter which linked pages are followed/kept.
